objective: Complete the first live end-to-end Rhino CAD MCP proof of concept now that a fresh Claude session has confirmed rhino-cad is visible in-session and Rhino 8 is running.
instructions: Observation only: do not fix or reconfigure the bridge, MCP runtime, Claude setup, orientation system, or Git tooling during this run.
Use the current fresh Claude session where rhino-cad resources/tools are already visible.
Load the rhino-chatgpt-orientation skill in operator mode.
Synchronize clean main, discover this request, and run ./exchange.sh prepare bridge-phase17-001.
Create .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase17-001/session-log.json and log each stage with timestamp, outcome, elapsed time when measurable, retries, tool used, and manual intervention.
Record baseline session facts including Claude version/model, session starting directory, base commit, Git cleanliness, and visible rhino-cad tool/resource inventory.
Run rhino_status and rhino_list_documents. Record exact results, instance/document IDs, timing, ambiguity, and retries.

Protect all existing user documents. Create a dedicated document named RHINO_CHATGPT_BRIDGE_POC_004 with rhino_create_document. If safe isolation cannot be demonstrated, stop before mutation and report a high-severity blocker.
List documents again, identify the new document ID, activate/target it if required, inspect it, and prove it is empty before creating geometry.
Create a deterministic three-solid assembly only in the isolated POC document: rectangular base, centered vertical cylindrical pedestal, and smaller rectangular top cap.
Create layer BRIDGE_POC_004 if supported and place all three objects on it.
Assign names and metadata to each object: role, created_by=bridge-phase17-001, revision=1, and operation_id. Read metadata back and preserve exact GUIDs.
Validate each object with rhino_validate or equivalent and record validity, solidity, manifold state, naked edges if returned, bbox, area, volume, and metadata.
Run rhino_validate_assembly and record invalid/non-solid IDs, duplicates, interference findings, metadata gaps, inconclusive checks, and limitations.

Capture visual evidence with rhino_capture_views or rhino_visual_qa, including an isometric and at least one orthographic/secondary view. Preserve PNG/contact sheet, manifest, and scene archive if generated.
Copy controller-reviewable artifacts into .bridge/artifacts/bridge-phase17-001/ without altering contents.

Save the isolated document to .bridge/artifacts/bridge-phase17-001/RHINO_CHATGPT_BRIDGE_POC_004.3dm with rhino_save_as if supported. Do not overwrite an existing file. Record save/readback verification and file size.
Re-inspect the saved POC document and record final document ID, active state, object/layer counts, GUIDs, and validity. Leave the POC document open for user inspection.

Create .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase17-001/workflow-assessment.json with architecture path, stage metrics, session validation, tool inventory, preflight, isolation, CAD operations, metadata, validation, artifacts, save, final state, retries/errors, manual interventions, ambiguities, friction points, and recommendations.
Create .bridge/evidence/bridge-phase17-001/operator-experience.md describing what felt smooth or awkward and ranking the top five workflow improvements by impact.
Do not modify implementation/configuration files during this baseline.
Run git diff --check and verify only Phase 17 evidence/artifacts/report files are added.
Commit evidence/artifacts as the work commit and capture RESULT_COMMIT.
Create .bridge/reports/bridge-phase17-001.json with ack exactly BRIDGE-PHASE17-LIVE-RHINO-20260924-C6F18B-OPERATOR-ACK, exact base_commit, RESULT_COMMIT, and branch operator/bridge-phase17-001.
Classify the full path as COMPLETE, PARTIAL, or BLOCKED and name the first failing stage if not COMPLETE.
Run python3 .bridge/bridge_cli.py verify-report bridge-phase17-001 and require REPORT_OK.
Commit the report separately, push operator/bridge-phase17-001, and do not merge it.
constraints: Never mutate existing user Rhino documents.
Require isolated document identity before mutation.
Do not fix issues during this run.
Do not install dependencies, change config, restart services, force push, or merge.
